title: Sarfatti's Navy friend and the living craft on the East Coast

tellings.quote: they couldn't breach the craft. They couldn't get inside the craft because the craft works. It's alive. It's conscious and it's got an attitude that unless you vibrate at the right level, you can't get in the craft.

plain: At a Navy facility on the US East Coast, the story goes, people held a craft they could not get inside, because the craft is alive and conscious and will only let in someone who "vibrate[s] at the right level". The UFO researcher Grant Cameron tells Michels this as something he heard from the physicist Jack Sarfatti, who had it from a friend in the Navy. Cameron says the craft "works" and has "an attitude". If true, it would mean that efforts to take apart and copy such craft run into a machine that chooses who comes in.
